title: Canada is unaffected: a Canadian company gets 404 on every India master route and gains no India rows
Spec covers the matrix (7 profile types, 14 record types, 30 rule categories: 29 from IN-2 and the GST return limit from IN-4); a new India company has no statutory rules seeded
Statutory rule: bad rate, bad link and missing source are refused; draft until approved; a later version ends the earlier one the day before; same date twice is refused
Company profile: invalid IEC / Udyam and unknown fields are refused; a rule reference must exist; a later effective date adds a version and keeps the earlier one
Vendor profile and company isolation: PAN validated; a record of another company is not found; an India vendor gets PAN, MSME and TDS section
GST registrations: another PAN is refused for the company; a second state is added; a change with a later date supersedes the old row (end date the day before) and keeps it
Roles: an Editor sets item HSN/SAC and records but cannot change company or account mappings or add/approve rules; HSN and UQC formats are checked
